messages:
jess: quick design question — for auto-fallback we need to balance signal clarity vs complexity. do we show two explicit knobs (p95 / error%) or a single 'confidence' band?
ryan: two knobs. SREs want to tune latency separately from error classes. a single band hides the tradeoffs and will lead to confusion.
priya: agree two, but include quick presets (conservative, normal, aggressive) so product teams can move fast. collapse advanced options by default.
ajess: good. proposed hosted defaults: p95=450ms, error_pct=0.8%. thoughts?
alex: fine for short chat flows; embeddings routes should inherit a different preset. add per-route presets.
ryan: UI must list which error events count (5xx, model_timeout, model_reject, kv_cache_miss). clarify counts to avoid "why didn't it fallback" tickets.
priya: feature idea: live preview that shows estimated_switch_rate computed from sampled telemetry (last 24-72h). show matched/total and a small histogram.
ops-bot: warning: full-window scans are heavy. recommend default preview sample_pct=5% and cap query to safe window.
emily: for audit sampling defaults: canary=12%, auto-fallback=2%. surface an estimated storage/cost delta badge when enabling capture.
ryan: add a "capture full payload" toggle (default off). for hosted show a privacy indicator when on. private deployments can default on.
jess: operator flow: overrides must be recorded with reason+optional ttl and appear in the rollout timeline. allow short undo (5m) after override.
priya: oscillation control: min_switch_interval and cool_down windows. propose min_switch_interval=5m and exponential backoff for repeated switches. show current backoff state in UI.
ryan: also require min_consecutive_matches for a rule to trigger (e.g., 10 consecutive requests or sustained window). reduces flapping on bursty traffic.
ops-bot: note: tagging matched_rule_id onto telemetry events aids debugging but increases size (~+7%). make tagging opt-in.
alex: the rule authoring UX — give a boolean builder (status==500 OR msg_contains("OOM") OR latency>1000) with live sample matches. templates for common patterns.
priya: and a small cheat-sheet in the UI explaining event taxonomies and retention.
emily: expose playback API: GET /api/v1/rollouts/{id}/playback?from=&to=&sample_pct=. require operator role and log access. include dry_run mode for previews.
jess: great. i'll make a mock: two numeric inputs, preset dropdown, advanced rule-builder panel with live preview, hysteresis controls, audit-sample toggle & cost badge, override timeline. will post by tomorrow AM.
ryan: i'll add API stub and migration guidance for existing configs (auto-map old error-only rules).
priya: i'll add runbook checklist items: audit retention, override review cadence, escalation play.
ops-bot: scheduled: prototype review meeting tomorrow 10:30am PT.
emily: i'll prototype the sampler with 72h @5% on staging and report perf metrics.
jess: thanks all — this feels actionable. :thumbsup:
